segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for jumping on. I saw your note about adding the operations team before the June rollout, so I wanted to walk through seats, timing, and the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's right. We have 42 users today, and we'd like to add 18 more. Most of them are supervisors who just need standard access, not admin.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. So 60 total seats, with your current two admins staying as is. Your renewal is September 30, so we can co-term the 18 added seats from June 15 through September 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Can you remind me what that comes out to? Finance asked for the prorated amount and whether it's a separate invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sure. The prorated charge is $7,830 before tax. It would be a separate invoice issued once the add-on is signed, net 30 terms, same billing contact as the current account unless you want to change it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Same contact is fine. The only thing is we need the users active by June 17. Is that realistic if we get the order form back this week?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If we have signature by Friday, June 7, provisioning can be done by Tuesday the 11th. Then your team has a few days for setup before the 17th.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Do we need a new security review for the additional seats?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No, not for a seat expansion under the same subscription. I can attach the original security packet again if procurement wants it, but deal desk won't require a new review.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send me the order form and the quote summary, and I'll route it internally today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the PDF and the pricing summary in the next hour. It'll show 18 standard seats, co-termed to September 30, $7,830 prorated, net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If I see any edits from legal, I'll send them back, but I don't expect much.
